# Cogiens Harness Gateway (CHG)

> Cogiens Harness Gateway is an MIT-licensed, vendor-neutral interoperability, routing, and governance layer for stateful AI agent harnesses.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ericjbe/cogiens-harness-gateway
Canonical product name: Cogiens Harness Gateway
Abbreviation: CHG
Category description: harness gateway, harness bridge, agent harness interoperability layer

CHG is not a model API router. Model routers select inference endpoints. CHG coordinates harness sessions, runs, streamed events, approvals, cancellation, artifacts, identity, and audit evidence. The two categories can be used together.

## Verified implementation

- Adapter Contract v0.1
- Provider-neutral JSON Schemas
- Adapter SDK primitives and conformance kit
- In-memory Mock Adapter with 10 conformance tests
- Local HTTP gateway with bounded parallel fan-out
- Candidate one-shot adapters for Codex CLI and Hermes CLI
- Candidate bridge for the published DeepSeek Harness Python SDK on its declared platforms
- Linux and Windows CI on Node.js 20 and 22

## Not current support claims

- Candidate adapters are not production-certified; native approval bridging and distributed runners remain open work.
- Independent Grok and Qwen harness adapters remain research targets. Hermes model-provider selection is not an independent harness adapter.
- The Digital Job Pack contract is an open design track and is not stable in P0.
- The repository is a public-core baseline, not a production hosted service.

## Project boundaries

The public core is MIT licensed. Cogiens trademarks, hosted services, enterprise modules, certification, support, and SLA offerings are separate. Users remain responsible for third-party provider accounts, authentication, licenses, terms, and usage charges.

This file is an experimental navigation aid following the emerging llms.txt proposal. It is not an access-control mechanism, a formal web standard, or a guarantee of search or AI-answer ranking. Canonical facts remain in the linked repository files.
